Weather-forecast (Open-Meteo NWP) lane is NOW THIS TRACK'S (owner 2026-09-19). Agri deletes its inert packages; lift from the tree at c922509d (code commits: e66dbc36 schema, c9c5256c ingest domain, a1b3a497 verifier fixes; c922509d itself is docs-only, so diff those three, not it): warehouse/schemas/weather_forecast.py (19-column frozen schema, grain cell_id/valid_time/variable, missing_reason enum, wind as u/v) and ingest/weather_forecast/ (bounded Open-Meteo single-run fetch: 64 MiB / 120 s, 429 -> OpenMeteoRateLimitError no retry, u = -speed*sin(dir), precipitation valid_time shifted one hour earlier). Plan: .omc/ultrapilot-20260918/W8-E-PLAN.md (column contract, four-rung ladder, availability keying, five slices; the codex branch is synthetic-fixture-only). Live probe 2026-09-19 (.omc/research/forecast-s3-probe-20260919/, gfs_global run 2026-09-18T00:00) SETTLED both conventions: multi-location requests return a JSON array in request order with each object's snapped coordinates (verify pairing, do not trust order); the hourly precipitation timestamp labels the START of its accumulation hour (00:00..23:00 sums reproduce the provider's daily precipitation_sum exactly at four locations over three days), so the one-hour-earlier shift in ingest/weather_forecast/open_meteo.py is WRONG and must be deleted when lifting, which also removes the S7 negative lead_hours row. Wind u/v, calm handling, bounded fetch and 429 handling were judged sound. Open style findings S6 (duplicated variable catalogue, no equality test) and S7 (negative lead_hours row before model_init_time) in .omc/ultrapilot-20260918/STYLE-REVIEW-W8.md. Needs a spec amendment: which kind= provider-issued projections use (D2 says the ML service writes kind=forecast; layer-lanes.md §3 provenance columns assume an ensemble) and an httpx-capable pipeline layer in the ML service. Open-Meteo's own docs say the hourly precipitation value sums the PRECEDING hour; the provider's daily precipitation_sum proves it is the FOLLOWING hour, so do not trust that doc line either. Also to retire or re-point when taking the lane: conductor/tracks/weather_forecast_parquet_lane_20260911/ (lists the deleted schema as a future artifact) and the weather-forecast row in conductor/RUNBOOK.md.
